result.rationale: Bear River Midstream, LLC launched as an active U.S. gas-storage platform when an I Squared affiliate bought 100% of Belle Butte LLC on 2026-06-30. No existing company or later ownership transfer was found.

identityResolution.boundary: One platform. Bear River operates it; Belle Butte LLC owns the two storage operators. Fields, facilities, pipelines and subsidiaries remain underlying assets.
identityResolution.caveat: Bear River LLC's exact equity link to the Subterra/Belle Butte chain is not disclosed.

currentOwners.fund: ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund III, L.P.
currentOwners.vehicle: Subterra Energy Holdings, LLC (parent); Subterra Energy Borrower, LLC (buyer)
currentOwners.stake: 100% of Belle Butte LLC; Bear River LLC/upstream percentages NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED

formerOwners.organization: Spire Midstream LLC, wholly owned by Spire Inc.
formerOwners.vehicle: Spire Inc. > Spire Resources LLC > Spire Midstream LLC > Belle Butte LLC

ownershipResolution.chain: The agreement names ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund III, L.P. as Buyer Fund/equity provider and guarantor. Subterra Holdings parents Subterra Borrower; Borrower owns Belle Butte and its two operators.

operatingResolution.scope: Two facilities/three fields in WY and OK; 72 Bcf certificated working-gas capacity.
operatingResolution.stallion: Evanston/Uinta County, WY; former Spire Storage West; Belle Butte and Clear Creek fields; 55 Bcf; interconnects Kern River, Ruby, MountainWest, MountainWest Overthrust and Northwest.
operatingResolution.saltPlains: Manchester/Grant County, OK; former Spire Storage Salt Plains; 17 Bcf; interconnects Southern Star and ONEOK Oklahoma Gas Transmission.
operatingResolution.customers: Utilities, pipelines, generators, industrials, marketers and producers.
operatingResolution.management: Scott Smith, CEO; continuing Spire Storage leadership and operations teams.
operatingResolution.pipelineBoundary: Named systems are interconnects; conveyed facility pipelines were not separately enumerated.

acquisitionExitCheck.buyerAtClosing: Subterra Energy Borrower, LLC, successor to Subterra Energy Holdings, LLC
acquisitionExitCheck.scope: 100% of Belle Butte LLC, including both storage operators.
acquisitionExitCheck.consideration: $650m base; closing 8-K reports $657m after adjustments: $607m cash plus $50m fixed deferred by 2027-09-30.
acquisitionExitCheck.regulatory: Required approvals/waivers obtained and HSR waiting period expired. Salt Plains filed a FERC change-in-circumstances report 2026-07-10; no separate transfer order located.
acquisitionExitCheck.financing: $325m Subterra Borrower senior secured term loan B rated 2026-05-27; acquisition debt, not equity.
acquisitionExitCheck.postClosingCheck: No transfer, recapitalization, sale or signed pending ownership deal found through 2026-08-19.

milestones.event: Spire and I Squared announced the $650m base-price sale.
Subterra Borrower bought Belle Butte; Bear River launched and closing became effective.

beforeAfterChanges.platform: Spire Storage -> Bear River Midstream, LLC
beforeAfterChanges.owner: Spire Inc./Spire Midstream -> I Squared-attributed Subterra chain
beforeAfterChanges.Wyoming: Spire Storage West -> Stallion Gas Storage
beforeAfterChanges.Oklahoma: Spire Storage Salt Plains -> Salt Plains Gas Storage

unresolvedQuestions: Exact Bear River LLC-to-Subterra/Belle Butte ownership link.
Complete legal inventory of facility pipelines.
result.recommendedListAction: Create one active U.S. PortCo, Bear River Midstream; add I Squared with the disclosed fund/Subterra vehicles; record Spire as former owner; keep all fields, facilities and legal entities beneath the platform.

confidenceNormalization.basis: The staged summary preserves the accepted overall confidence and appends a more specific evidence-gap qualifier; the research decision is unchanged.
